When you want to take your skin rejuvenation routine to the next level, SkinPen® Microneedling may be worth considering.   Microneedling is a minimally invasive treatment designed to stimulate your skin’s natural healing response and support the production of collagen and elastin. Rather than simply treating the surface of your skin, microneedling works by creating controlled microchannels that encourage the skin’s natural renewal process.   At dermani MEDSPA® , we use SkinPen®, an FDA-cleared microneedling device, to help improve the appearance of acne scars, fine lines, wrinkles, and other skin texture concerns.   If you’ve been searching for microneedling near me or wondering whether SkinPen® is right for your skin, here’s what you should know.   What Is SkinPen® Microneedling? SkinPen® Microneedling is a professional skin rejuvenation treatment that uses tiny, sterile needles to create thousands of controlled microchannels in the skin.   These microchannels trigger the body’s natural wound-healing response without significantly damaging the surrounding tissue. As the skin responds, it begins a natural remodeling process that includes the production of new collagen and elastin.   This is why microneedling is also commonly associated with collagen induction therapy .   Unlike treatments designed primarily to cleanse, hydrate, or exfoliate the surface of your skin, SkinPen® Microneedling focuses on encouraging your skin to renew itself from within.   How Does SkinPen® Stimulate Natural Collagen? Collagen is one of the proteins responsible for giving your skin its structure, firmness, and smooth appearance. Unfortunately, natural collagen production decreases as we age.   Sun exposure, environmental factors, acne, and the natural aging process can also contribute to changes in your skin’s appearance and texture.   SkinPen® Microneedling creates controlled micro-injuries that activate your body’s natural healing process. As your skin repairs these microchannels, collagen and elastin production is stimulated.   Over time, this remodeling process can help the skin look smoother, firmer, and more even.   Unlike a treatment designed to provide an immediate cosmetic effect, the benefits of microneedling can continue developing as the skin produces and remodels collagen following treatment.   What Skin Concerns Can Microneedling Improve? One reason medical microneedling has become such a popular skin rejuvenation treatment is its versatility. Rather than addressing just one concern, SkinPen® can help improve several common skin issues.   Microneedling for Acne Scars Acne may eventually disappear, but the scars it leaves behind can last much longer.   Indented acne scars develop when the skin doesn’t produce enough collagen during the healing process. Because SkinPen® stimulates the body’s natural collagen response, microneedling for acne scars can help improve the appearance of certain types of acne scarring and uneven texture.   As new collagen forms and the skin remodels, acne scars may gradually appear smoother and less noticeable.   Results aren’t necessarily immediate. Because your body needs time to produce and remodel collagen, improvements typically develop gradually after treatment.   Microneedling for Fine Lines and Wrinkles Fine lines are another common reason people explore microneedling.   As collagen and elastin production naturally decline with age, the skin can become thinner and less firm, contributing to the development of lines and wrinkles.   Microneedling for wrinkles and fine lines stimulates the skin’s natural renewal process, helping improve its overall texture and appearance over time.   SkinPen® can be a great option for people who want to incorporate collagen stimulation into a broader anti-aging skincare routine.   Enlarged-Looking Pores While you can’t permanently change the actual size of your pores, improving the surrounding skin’s texture can help make enlarged pores appear less noticeable.   By stimulating collagen and encouraging skin renewal, SkinPen® Microneedling can help create a smoother, more refined-looking complexion.   Uneven Skin Texture If your skin feels rough, bumpy, or uneven, microneedling can help encourage a smoother surface.   This makes SkinPen® a popular choice for people dealing with a combination of concerns rather than one isolated issue.   For example, someone may simultaneously have mild acne scarring, enlarged-looking pores, fine lines, and uneven texture. A treatment that supports overall skin remodeling can address multiple aspects of the complexion at once.   Stretch Marks and Scars Microneedling isn’t limited to the face. SkinPen® Microneedling can also help improve the appearance of certain scars and stretch marks on the body by supporting the skin’s natural remodeling process.   Scars can form when the body produces collagen differently as it heals from an injury, surgery, acne, or other trauma to the skin. By creating controlled microchannels, microneedling stimulates the body’s natural wound-healing response and encourages new collagen and elastin production. Over time, this process may help improve the texture and overall appearance of certain scars.   Because stretch marks are also a type of scar caused by changes within the skin’s structure, microneedling may be used on certain areas of the body to help make them appear smoother and less noticeable.   Whether you’re interested in microneedling for scars, stretch marks, or uneven skin texture , your provider can evaluate the treatment area and determine whether SkinPen® Microneedling is appropriate for your specific concerns.   What to Expect During a SkinPen® Microneedling Treatment If you’ve never had microneedling before, the idea of tiny needles can sound intimidating. SkinPen® treatments, however, are designed to create precise, controlled microchannels in the skin.   Before treatment begins, your provider will prepare your skin and discuss what you can expect during and after the procedure.   The SkinPen® device is then moved across the treatment area, creating controlled microchannels at a depth appropriate for your treatment.   Following microneedling, it’s normal for the skin to appear pink or red and feel sensitive, similar to a mild sunburn. The intensity and duration of these effects can vary from person to person.   Your provider will give you specific aftercare instructions, which are important to follow while your skin is recovering.   How Long Does It Take to See Microneedling Results? Microneedling is a process rather than an overnight transformation.   Because SkinPen® relies on your body’s natural collagen-building response, results develop gradually as the skin heals and remodels itself.   You may notice improvements in the appearance and feel of your skin as it recovers, while changes related to collagen production can continue developing in the weeks following treatment.   This gradual improvement is one of the reasons consistency can be important when incorporating SkinPen® into a long-term skincare plan.   How Many Microneedling Treatments Do You Need? The ideal number of treatments depends on your skin, your concerns, and what you’re hoping to achieve.   Some people may choose microneedling primarily for overall skin rejuvenation, while someone treating noticeable acne scars or texture concerns may benefit from a series of treatments.   SkinPen® treatments are generally spaced apart to give the skin time to complete its natural healing and collagen-building process between appointments.   During your consultation at dermani MEDSPA®, your provider can evaluate your skin and recommend a treatment schedule based on your individual goals.   Can You Combine Microneedling With Other Skin Treatments? One of the advantages of professional skincare is that you don’t necessarily have to rely on one treatment to address every concern.   Different treatments accomplish different things.   SkinPen® Microneedling primarily focuses on collagen stimulation and skin remodeling , while other professional treatments may focus more heavily on exfoliation, hydration, pigmentation, or surface-level skin renewal.   Depending on your skin and treatment schedule, your provider may recommend incorporating services such as: Hydrafacial® for cleansing, exfoliation, and hydration Medical-grade chemical peels for exfoliation and uneven tone DiamondGlow® for exfoliation, extraction, and serum infusion at participating locations Dermaplaning for surface exfoliation and smoother-looking skin Medical-grade skincare products to support your overall skincare routine These treatments aren’t necessarily performed at the same appointment as SkinPen®. Instead, your provider can help determine how to appropriately space and combine services based on your skin’s needs.   A customized treatment plan allows you to address multiple concerns while giving your skin appropriate time to recover between more intensive treatments.   Microneedling vs. a Traditional Facial: Which Should You Choose? Traditional facials can be great for cleansing, hydration, relaxation, and routine skin maintenance. But if your main concern involves acne scars, fine lines, wrinkles, or uneven skin texture , you may want a treatment that goes beyond the skin’s surface.   That’s where SkinPen® Microneedling stands out.   Rather than simply exfoliating dead skin cells or applying moisturizing products, SkinPen® encourages a natural process within the skin that supports collagen and elastin production.   That doesn’t mean you have to choose one or the other.   Hydrating and exfoliating treatments can complement a long-term skincare routine that includes collagen-stimulating treatments such as microneedling. The key is choosing each treatment for the job it does best.   Is SkinPen® Microneedling Right for You? SkinPen® may be worth considering if you’re looking to improve the appearance of: Acne scars Fine lines and wrinkles Uneven skin texture Enlarged-looking pores Certain types of scars Stretch marks Overall skin quality However, everyone’s skin is different. Your medical history, current skin condition, medications, and other factors can affect whether microneedling is appropriate for you.   That’s why a professional consultation is an important first step.   Why Choose dermani MEDSPA® for SkinPen® Microneedling? When searching for the best microneedling treatment near you , the device being used and the experience of your provider matter.   At dermani MEDSPA® , we use SkinPen®, the first FDA-cleared microneedling device, to provide professional collagen induction treatments designed around your individual skincare needs.   But your skincare journey doesn’t have to begin and end with a single treatment.   Our approach to skin rejuvenation includes a variety of advanced aesthetic treatments, allowing your provider to recommend services based on what your skin actually needs. Whether your primary concern is acne scars, fine lines, texture, pigmentation, dryness, or general skin rejuvenation, we can help create a treatment plan based on your goals.   Give Your Skin a Reason to Make More Collagen Great skincare isn’t only about what you put on your skin. Sometimes, it’s about encouraging your skin to do more of what it naturally does.   By stimulating the body’s natural healing and collagen-building processes, SkinPen® Microneedling offers a different approach to improving acne scars, fine lines, wrinkles, and uneven skin texture.   And because collagen production takes time, the changes can continue developing after your appointment as your skin goes through its natural remodeling process.   Ready to find out if SkinPen® is right for your skin?   Schedule a free consultation at your nearest dermani MEDSPA® location to learn more about SkinPen® Microneedling and create a personalized skin rejuvenation plan based on your concerns and goals.
